Tool icons used by `render_whoburnedmore.py`.

Taken from [`@lobehub/icons-static-svg`](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons)
v1.95.1 (MIT, © LobeHub). The logos themselves are trademarks of their
respective owners.

Exception: `opencode.svg` is redrawn from opencode.ai's official favicon
(white frame, grey block), keeping its own colours.

Each file is a 24×24 `currentColor` SVG; the renderer inlines the `<path>`
elements and tints them with the tool's colour.
